rule: Only the user's explicit accept or decline decision changes a review group status.

lesson6-object-category-system.acceptedJob: Make the object relation and referent genuine choices while the application derives objective case and prominence.

lesson6-monadic-valence.acceptedJob: Let the user choose the monadic object meaning and make the application supply ne, tē, or tla.

lesson6-dyadic-valence.acceptedJob: Make specific object person and number genuine choices while the application builds the complete va1-va2 object.

lesson6-third-person-va1.acceptedJob: Make the application derive c, qu, or qui from a third-person object and the actual VNC boundary.

lesson6-projective-va1-va2.acceptedJob: Make object person and number drive both object carriers and every licensed phonological variant.

lesson6-projective-object-paradigm.acceptedJob: Make the complete specific-object form and contextual interpretation automatic from the selected object participant.

lesson6-reflexive-object-structure.acceptedJob: Make a reflexive or licensed reciprocal choice copy the subject relation into the exact automatic object dyad.

lesson6-reflexive-object-paradigm.acceptedJob: Build the complete reflexive paradigm and block reciprocal meaning for every singular subject.
